# GymShed

> Free, open-source gym & body-weight tracker (AGPL-3.0). Runs as a standalone
> Android app (sideloaded APK) or self-hosted with Docker (passkey profiles,
> multi-device sync, PWA). No account required, no cloud, no telemetry.

## Docs
- [Complete reference](https://gymshed.app/docs.html): every feature, self-hosting, every .env setting, AI Coach, imports (FitNotes/Strong/Hevy/Apple Health), backups, MCP server, troubleshooting
- [HTTP API](https://gymshed.app/api.html): OpenAPI spec, also at [openapi.yaml](https://gymshed.app/openapi.yaml)
- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gymshed/GymShed/main/README.md): project overview in Markdown
- [Documentation index](https://github.com/gymshed/GymShed/blob/main/docs/README.md): every guide by audience, plus an [FAQ](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gymshed/GymShed/main/docs/FAQ.md)

## Try & get it
- [Live demo](https://gymshed.app/demo/): the real app with example data, in the browser
- [Android APK](https://github.com/gymshed/GymShed/releases/latest): signed, sideloadable, in three sizes (Standard with 180 px animations, Plus with 240 px, HD with 360 px); each has its SHA-256 beside it on the GitHub release
- [About](https://gymshed.app/about.html): the story and every release

## How it is built
- Developed with Claude Code (Anthropic's coding agent); changes are reviewed, tested and released by the maintainer. The app itself needs no AI service; the AI coach and MCP server are optional.

## Source & community
- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/gymshed/GymShed): code, issues, pull requests, releases
- [GitLab mirror](https://gitlab.com/gymshed/gymshed): CI, APK and image builds
- [Discord](https://github.com/gymshed/GymShed/discussions): release announcements and self-hosting help
